For people working on ChatGPT at OpenAI, here are some fun puzzle games you might enjoy:

- There are 4 places to set up browser access for ChatGPT app. Can you find them all?

-  There are 3 places to store passwords in ChatGPT app. Can you find them all? Bonus: if you can also tell which part of app uses which passwords.

- How many different modes are in ChatGPT? Hint: It's more than just Chat, Work, Codex.

- Projects for each mode in ChatGPT is different in their own mysterious ways. Can you list all the differences?

- If your user eventually had created 100+ projects, list all the ways things will be unusable.

- Your user frequently moves between desktop, laptop and phone. Draw a full 3 dimensional tensor of modes, device and capabilities.

Good luck!
